id: JSON tuple [profile, sessionId, exact reference value]
identityLimit: Reference identity, not canonical filesystem identity. Different spelling/case may remain distinct.
sessionBinding: Native stored session ID plus profile
messageBinding: Native SQLite Message ID preferred; position fallback explicitly identified
taskBinding: Nearest preceding native user Message ID / fallback position; not a new backend Task
semantics: COMPLETED label means native file operation confirmed, never entire task completed. CANCELLED has adapter coverage but no production native mapping in this phase.
durability: Native transcript and current file only; no new Artifact Store or DB
createdUpdated: Native timestamp seconds normalized to milliseconds; distinct message occurrences retained
